card.text: Earth-sized planet in the temperate zone of a red dwarf, 178 parsecs away.

introduction.text: Kepler-186 f is 1.17 times as wide as Earth and circles its red dwarf every 130 days. Only its size and orbit are measured; here it is a plain gray sphere.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius. No colour, surface or atmosphere of this planet is observed.
